Container.Name: PosterView
Container.Overview: Self-hosted artwork manager for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Browse libraries, including collections, and replace posters, backgrounds, and logos from multiple artwork providers.
Container.Description: PosterView provides one interface for managing media artwork across Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. Browse titles and collections; apply posters, backgrounds, banners, and logos from ThePosterDB, Fanart.tv, TheTVDB, AniList, and MediUX; upload custom artwork; and revert earlier changes from apply history. Credentials are encrypted at rest, and application data persists in the configured Data path.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: poster artwork plex jellyfin emby theposterdb fanart tvdb anilist mediux

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the PosterView web UI

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, encryption key, settings, and apply history

Config.Name: Require Login
Config.Description: false disables login for ALL connections, including reverse proxies and remote access. true requires administrator login unless local-network bypass is enabled in Settings. Defaults to false. Use only on a trusted network when disabled.

Config.Name: Administrator Username
Config.Description: Username when Require Login is true. Defaults to admin.

Config.Name: Administrator Password
Config.Description: Password for the PosterView sign-in screen. Leave blank to generate one in /data/admin-password.txt.
